title: Projected Penalty-Gradient Tracking for Communication-Efficient Byzantine-Resilient Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate communication-efficient federated learning over heterogeneous datasets in the presence of Byzantine adversaries capable of uploading arbitrary information. Penalty-based methods bound the influence of each worker through the bounded gradient of a penalty function; however, the bound is lost once the uploads are compressed, since a Byzantine worker can accumulate an unbounded state at the server. To retain the Byzantine resilience under compressed uploads, we propose a projected penalty-gradient tracking framework, where each honest worker uploads a compressed residual of its penalty gradient and the server projects each reconstructed state onto the known penalty-gradient ball. translated_title: 面向通信高效且拜占庭容错联邦学习的投影罚函数梯度追踪方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在异构数据集上、存在能够上传任意信息的拜占庭攻击者情形下的通信高效联邦学习问题。基于罚函数的方法通过罚函数的有界梯度来约束每个工作节点的影响；然而，一旦上传内容被压缩，这种约束就会失效，因为拜占庭工作节点可以在服务器端积累无界的状态。为了在压缩上传的条件下保持拜占庭鲁棒性，我们提出了一个投影罚函数梯度追踪框架：每个诚实工作节点上传其罚函数梯度的压缩残差，服务器则将每个重构状态投影到已知的罚函数梯度球上。该框架适用于任何收缩型压缩器，并衍生出两种算法：具有一致稀疏化的容错近端梯度算法（FRPG-CS），其共享掩码由新抽取的保留行加以保护；以及惰性聚合的FRPG（L……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种投影罚函数梯度追踪框架，使联邦学习在压缩通信条件下仍能保持拜占庭攻击鲁棒性，并给出两种高效算法。
en_tdlr: A projected penalty-gradient tracking framework is proposed to preserve Byzantine resilience in federated learning even under compressed uploads, yielding two communication-efficient algorithms (FRPG-CS and lazily aggregated FRPG).
